description: Find Spanish open datasets (datos abiertos) in datos.gob.es by topic. Compare publishers, formats, distributions and declared licences with official catalog links.

defaultPrompt: Find Spanish housing datasets and compare publishers, formats and declared licences.
Busca datos abiertos de transporte y enlaza las fichas de datos.gob.es.
Encuentra datasets de empleo y muestra qué metadatos faltan antes de descargarlos.
interface.longDescription: Find public datasets from Spain in the official datos.gob.es catalog. Search by topic and compare the listed publisher, file formats, distribution links and declared licence for each result. Follow pagination to review more datasets and use official catalog links to check missing metadata. Useful for research, data projects and finding sources on housing, transport, employment and other topics. The connector compares catalog metadata; it does not download or inspect data files, and catalog entries alone do not confirm freshness, access or permission to reuse a distribution.
